content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest
content.description: Locate and run BA v11 production backtest with new state series substituted. Critical because state-machine standalone wins don't [REDACTED] transfer (v2g lesson: +1.28pp standalone but -2.40pp integrated). Compare canonical TQ34b vs new variant on full BA v11 stack.

content.subject: Catalog state dependencies in BA v11
content.description: Identify EVERY state-dependent filter/parameter in BA v11 stack: SV_TIGHT, overheat AVOID, D1 RE_BACKLOG state condition, cash_etf_states, anything inside simulate_holistic_nav.py that uses state_by_date.

content.subject: Build progressive strip variants
content.description: Build BA v11 variants that progressively remove state-deps: strip1 (no SV_TIGHT) → strip2 (no overheat) → strip3 (no D1 state) → strip4 (no cash_etf) → strip_clean (fully state-independent). Replace each removed state dep with state-free proxy.

content.subject: Cross-test strip variants × state series
content.description: Run integrated BA v11 with cross-product: (strip1, strip2, ..., strip_clean) × (TQ34b, DT_10_25_25). Find combination that: (a) maximizes state-independence, (b) achieves OOS performance ≥ TQ34b+full-state-deps baseline.

content.subject: Filter ablation analysis
content.description: Ablate each state-dependent filter individually to measure its marginal value. Identifies most/least impactful filters for tuning prioritization.

content.subject: Tune SV_TIGHT day thresholds
content.description: Sweep SV_TIGHT days_since_release thresholds per state: state 1→[15,30,45], state 2→[30,45,60,90], state 3→[30,45,60,90]. Find combination that improves OOS without overfitting IS.

content.subject: Tune AVOID_bear & overheat
content.description: Test (a) AVOID_bear with FA A/B-tier exempt (defensive stocks allowed in bear), (b) overheat broadened to state 4+5 with different Close/MA200 thresholds. Goal: better OOS risk management.

content.subject: Tune cash_etf parking
content.description: Sweep cash_etf_states: current {3:0.7}; test {2:0.3, 3:0.7}, {2:0.5, 3:0.7, 4:0.3}, {3:0.5} etc. Capture more idle cash productivity.

content.subject: Combined tuning + walk-forward
content.description: Test combinations of top OOS improvers: looser SVT + broader overheat + ETF in bear. Walk-forward validate. Best combo must beat V_PROD on OOS without IS overfit, with DD ≤ 22%.

content.subject: Cross-test filter × state series
content.description: 2×3 matrix: states {TQ34b, DT_10_25_25} × filters {V_PROD, C3_cons, C2_no_svt}. Does best filter tune cross-multiply with state tune, or do they conflict? Identify global optimum (state+filter combination).

content.subject: SVT lever refinement
content.description: Final refinement of SVT lever — test s3=120, s3=180, uniform tight, no-SVT alone, no-SVT+ETF. Find absolute sweet spot.

content.subject: Finalize production recommendation
content.description: Pick the production candidate based on refinement results. Write deployment summary + update MEMORY.md.

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test C3_cons
content.description: Run BA v11 pre-2014 sim (2007-2013) with C3_cons filters to verify cash_etf {2:0.5} doesn't destroy in 2008 GFC. Compare vs V_PROD pre-2014 baseline.

content.subject: Test C3_clean (no SVT) pre-2014
content.description: Verify removing SV_TIGHT entirely is safe pre-2014 (2007-2013). User insight: market matured, SVT was for immature pre-2014 era. Empirically validate before recommendation.

content.subject: V5 + DT integrated test
content.description: Test if DT_10_25_25 state-machine smoothing helps V5 (ETF_KELLY) integrated. Hypothesis: V5 more sensitive to state transitions than V11 (BAL) because 100% ETF parking amplifies transition friction. If yes, DT solves the noise problem for V5 specifically.

content.subject: Z1: V5 + DT + C3_clean combined
content.description: Test if filter tune (C3_clean = remove SVT) adds on top of state tune (DT_10_25_25) for V5 system. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ34b, DT} × filter {V_PROD, C3_clean}.

content.subject: Z2: V5+DT pre-2014 safety
content.description: Pre-2014 stress test for V5 + DT_10_25_25 integrated. Verify DT doesn't catastrophically fail 2008 GFC like cash_etf bear did. Single sim 2007-2013 with ETF_KELLY parking.

content.subject: B: V12.1 LAG + DT integrated
content.description: Test V12.1 architecture (BAL+LAGGED books) with DT_10_25_25 state smoothing. Plus ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD overlay. Goal: see if DT benefit transfers to V12.1's different book composition.

content.subject: C: Cross-architecture synthesis
content.description: Synthesize optimal stack across all dimensions: architecture (V11 vs V12.1), state (TQ vs DT), ensemble overlay, filter tune. Build final production recommendation matrix.

content.subject: V121_ENS + DT + C3_clean
content.description: Final untested combo: V12.1 ensemble + DT_10_25_25 state + C3_clean filter. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ, DT} × filter {V_PROD with Python SVT, C3_clean no SVT}. Determines if all 3 axes stack additively or conflict (like V11/V5).

content.subject: V5 V121_ENS+KELLY + DT test
content.description: Test V5 (V121_ENS architecture + ETF_KELLY) with DT_10_25_25 state. Hypothesis: KELLY amplifies state sensitivity like V11→V5 BAL did. Compare to canonical V5_TQ_KELLY ~26% per memory.

## ✅ V5=V121_ENS+KELLY+DT — HYPOTHESIS REJECTED (đã memorize)

### Canonical V5 validation
- V5_TQ_KELLY = **26.07%** Full CAGR ✅ matches memory note 26.09%
- V5_DT_KELLY = 24.79% → **-1.29pp** ❌

### KELLY amplification pattern (counter-intuitive)

| Configuration | DT Impact |
|---------------|-----------|
| V11 BAL+VN30 + BASE (no ensemble) | +0.28pp marginal |
| **V11 BAL+VN30 + KELLY (no ensemble)** | **+1.90pp** ⭐ |
| V121_ENS + BASE | +0.46pp marginal |
| **V121_ENS + KELLY (V5)** | **-1.29pp** ❌ HURT |

**KEY INSIGHT**: KELLY amplifies state effects in BOTH directions:
- WITHOUT ensemble: amplifies POSITIVE DT benefit (+1.90pp)
- WITH ensemble: amplifies NEGATIVE DT downside (-1.29pp)

**Why**: Ensemble's M1+M3 timing pre-empts state-machine timing. DT's slow CRISIS confirm DELAYS bull re-entry → KELLY's 100% parking AMPLIFIES this cost.

### Killer year: 2025 (strong bull)
- V5_TQ_KELLY 2025: +83.9%
- V5_DT_KELLY 2025: +62.4%
- **Δ = -21.5pp** (DT misses major rally)

### FINAL 5-system stack (per memory, validated)

| System | Architecture | State | ETF | Filter | Full CAGR |
|--------|--------------|-------|-----|--------|-----------|
| V1 | BAL+VN30 (no ens) | TQ34b | BASE | **C3_clean** | ~20.5% |
| V2 | BAL+LIVE | LIVE | BASE | C3_clean | ~20% |

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Paper-trade comparison report — 5 systems side-by-side.

Reads:
  data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv     (V1: V11 Song Sinh + Tam Quan v3.4b)
  data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv     (V2: V12 Âm Dương + Tam Quan v3.4b)
  data/pt_v12_live_logs.csv      (V3: V12 Âm Dương + LIVE Ngũ Hành Tinh Tế)
  data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv      (V4: V12.1 + Ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD + TQ v3.4b)
  data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv   (V5: V4 + Q2 Kelly NEUTRAL boost ETF{3:1.0})

Plus VNINDEX from BQ for the same window as a passive benchmark.

Writes:
  data/papertrade_compare5.md    — markdown comparison report
  data/papertrade_compare5.csv   — daily NAV/return for all 5 + VNI
"""
import os, sys, io, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
sys.path.insert(0, WORKDIR)
os.chdir(WORKDIR)
from simulate_holistic_nav import bq

SYSTEMS = [
    ("V1_V11_TQ34b",  "V1: V11 Song Sinh + TQ v3.4b",         "data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V2_V12_TQ34b",  "V2: V12 Âm Dương + TQ v3.4b",          "data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V3_V12_LIVE",   "V3: V12 Âm Dương + LIVE Tinh Tế",      "data/pt_v12_live_logs.csv"),
    ("V4_V121_ENS",   "V4: V12.1 + Ensemble (M1+M3r) + TQ34b","data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv"),
    ("V5_V121_ENS_Q2","V5: V4 + Kelly Q2 NEUTRAL{1.0}",        "data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv"),
]


def vni_series(start: str, end: str) -> pd.Series:
    df = bq(f"SELECT t.time, t.Close FROM tav2_bq.ticker AS t "
            f"WHERE t.ticker='VNINDEX' AND t.time BETWEEN DATE '{start}' AND DATE '{end}' "
            f"ORDER BY t.time")
    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])
    return df.set_index("time")["Close"]


def stats(nav: pd.Series) -> dict:
    nav = nav.dropna()
    if len(nav) < 2: return {}
    ret_total = nav.iloc[-1]/nav.iloc[0] - 1
    days = (nav.index[-1] - nav.index[0]).days
    years = days / 365.25
    cagr = (1+ret_total)**(1/years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0
    daily_ret = nav.pct_change().dropna()
    vol_ann = daily_ret.std() * np.sqrt(252)
    sharpe = (daily_ret.mean()*252)/vol_ann if vol_ann > 0 else 0
    peak = nav.cummax()
    dd = (nav-peak)/peak
    max_dd = dd.min()
    calmar = cagr/abs(max_dd) if max_dd < 0 else float("nan")
    return {"start": nav.index[0].date(), "end": nav.index[-1].date(),
            "days": days, "init": nav.iloc[0], "final": nav.iloc[-1],
            "ret_total": ret_total, "cagr": cagr, "vol_ann": vol_ann,
            "sharpe": sharpe, "max_dd": max_dd, "calmar": calmar}


def main():
    rows = {}
    nav_all = {}
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        full = os.path.join(WORKDIR, path)
        if not os.path.exists(full):
            print(f"  MISSING: {full}"); continue
        df = pd.read_csv(full, parse_dates=["ymd"]).sort_values("ymd")
        nav = df.set_index("ymd")["nav"]
        nav_all[key] = nav
        s = stats(nav); s["name"] = name; rows[key] = s

    if not rows:
        print("No logs found. Run pt_v11_tq34b.py / pt_v12_tq34b.py / pt_v12_live.py first.")
        return

    # VNI benchmark over same window

    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])
    return df.set_index("time")["Close"]


def stats(nav: pd.Series) -> dict:
    nav = nav.dropna()
    if len(nav) < 2: return {}
    ret_total = nav.iloc[-1]/nav.iloc[0] - 1
    days = (nav.index[-1] - nav.index[0]).days
    years = days / 365.25
    cagr = (1+ret_total)**(1/years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0
    daily_ret = nav.pct_change().dropna()
    vol_ann = daily_ret.std() * np.sqrt(252)
    sharpe = (daily_ret.mean()*252)/vol_ann if vol_ann > 0 else 0
    peak = nav.cummax()
    dd = (nav-peak)/peak
    max_dd = dd.min()
    calmar = cagr/abs(max_dd) if max_dd < 0 else float("nan")
    return {"start": nav.index[0].date(), "end": nav.index[-1].date(),
            "days": days, "init": nav.iloc[0], "final": nav.iloc[-1],
            "ret_total": ret_total, "cagr": cagr, "vol_ann": vol_ann,
            "sharpe": sharpe, "max_dd": max_dd, "calmar": calmar}


def main():
    rows = {}
    nav_all = {}
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        full = os.path.join(WORKDIR, path)
        if not os.path.exists(full):
            print(f"  MISSING: {full}"); continue
        df = pd.read_csv(full, parse_dates=["ymd"]).sort_values("ymd")
        nav = df.set_index("ymd")["nav"]
        nav_all[key] = nav
        s = stats(nav); s["name"] = name; rows[key] = s

    if not rows:
        print("No logs found. Run pt_v11_tq34b.py / pt_v12_tq34b.py / pt_v12_live.py first.")
        return

    # VNI benchmark over same window
    first = min(s["start"] for s in rows.values())
    last  = max(s["end"]   for s in rows.values())
    try:
        vni = vni_series(first.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), last.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        # rebase to 50B at first day
        vni_nav = (vni / vni.iloc[0]) * 50e9
        nav_all["VNI_BH"] = vni_nav
        rows["VNI_BH"] = {**stats(vni_nav), "name": "VNINDEX Buy & Hold (rebased 50B)"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  VNI load failed: {e}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Write markdown
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    now = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    md = []
    md.append(f"# Paper-Trade Comparison — 5 Systems\n")
    md.append(f"*Generated: {now}*\n")
    md.append(f"*Window: {first} → {last} ({(last-first).days} calendar days)*\n")
    md.append(f"*Init NAV: 50B VND fresh, all-cash, no positions (each system)*\n\n")

    md.append("## Headline metrics\n")
    md.append("| System | Final NAV | Total Ret | CAGR | Vol (ann) | Sharpe | Max DD | Calmar |")
    md.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    keys_order = ["V1_V11_TQ34b","V2_V12_TQ34b","V3_V12_LIVE","V4_V121_ENS","V5_V121_ENS_Q2","VNI_BH"]
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        md.append(f"| **{s['name']}** | {s['final']/1e9:.3f}B | "
                  f"{s['ret_total']*100:+.2f}% | {s['cagr']*100:+.2f}% | "
                  f"{s['vol_ann']*100:.2f}% | {s['sharpe']:+.2f} | "
                  f"{s['max_dd']*100:+.2f}% | {s['calmar']:+.2f} |")
    md.append("")

    # Delta vs V4_V121_ENS (leading backtest winner, baseline for V5 Q2 overlay)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows:
        ref_ret = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["ret_total"]
        ref_dd  = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["max_dd"]
        md.append("## Delta vs V4 V121_ENS (backtest winner baseline)\n")
        md.append("| System | ΔRet | ΔDD | Verdict |")
        md.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for k in ["V1_V11_TQ34b","V2_V12_TQ34b","V3_V12_LIVE","V5_V121_ENS_Q2","VNI_BH"]:
            if k not in rows: continue
            s = rows[k]
            dret = (s["ret_total"] - ref_ret) * 100
            ddd  = (s["max_dd"] - ref_dd) * 100
            verdict = ("Both better" if dret > 0 and ddd > 0
                       else "Return better, DD worse" if dret > 0
                       else "DD better, return worse" if ddd > 0
                       else "Both worse")
            md.append(f"| {s['name']} | {dret:+.2f}pp | {ddd:+.2f}pp | {verdict} |")
        md.append("")

    # V5 vs V4 (Kelly Q2 overlay watch — V5 expected to beat V4 by +1-4pp OOS in backtest)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows and "V5_V121_ENS_Q2" in rows:
        v4 = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]; v5 = rows["V5_V121_ENS_Q2"]
        d_ret = (v5["ret_total"] - v4["ret_total"]) * 100
        d_dd  = (v5["max_dd"] - v4["max_dd"]) * 100
        d_sh  = v5["sharpe"] - v4["sharpe"]
        md.append("## V5 (Kelly Q2 overlay) vs V4 (baseline ensemble) — KEY WATCH\n")
        md.append(f"- ΔRet  = **{d_ret:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: +1pp FULL / +4pp OOS)")
        md.append(f"- ΔDD   = **{d_dd:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: -4pp wider; gate: ≥ -6pp)")
        md.append(f"- ΔShar = **{d_sh:+.2f}**    (backtest expectation: ≈ flat or slight improvement)")
        gate = "🟢 GREEN" if (d_ret > -1 and d_dd > -6) else "🟡 YELLOW" if d_dd > -8 else "🔴 RED"
        md.append(f"- Gate verdict: **{gate}**")
        md.append("")

    # NAV curve snapshot every ~10 days
    md.append("## Weekly NAV snapshot (every ~5 trading days)\n")
    all_dates = sorted(set().union(*[set(nav.index) for nav in nav_all.values()]))
    snap_dates = all_dates[::5] + [all_dates[-1]]
    snap_dates = sorted(set(snap_dates))
    cols = ["Date"] + [rows[k]["name"] for k in keys_order if k in rows]
    md.append("| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |")
    md.append("|" + "|".join(["---"]*len(cols)) + "|")
    for d in snap_dates:
        row = [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")]
        for k in keys_order:
            if k not in nav_all: continue
            v = nav_all[k].asof(d)
            row.append(f"{v/1e9:.2f}B" if pd.notna(v) else "—")
        md.append("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |")
    md.append("")

    md.append("## Files\n")
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        md.append(f"- `{path}` — {name}")
    md.append(f"- `data/papertrade_compare5.csv` — daily NAV all systems\n")

    out_md = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.md")
    with open(out_md, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(md))
    print(f"Wrote {out_md}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CSV with daily NAV all systems
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_d = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.DatetimeIndex(all_dates))
    for k, nav in nav_all.items():
        all_d[k] = nav.reindex(all_d.index).ffill()
    all_d.index.name = "ymd"
    out_csv = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.csv")
    all_d.to_csv(out_csv)
    print(f"Wrote {out_csv}")

    # Console summary
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print(" PAPER-TRADE COMPARISON")
    print("="*80)
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        print(f" {s['name']:<40} ret {s['ret_total']*100:+6.2f}%  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:+6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_dd']*100:+6.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:+.2f}  Calmar {s['calmar']:+.2f}")
    print("="*80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest
content.description: Locate and run BA v11 production backtest with new state series substituted. Critical because state-machine standalone wins don't [REDACTED] transfer (v2g lesson: +1.28pp standalone but -2.40pp integrated). Compare canonical TQ34b vs new variant on full BA v11 stack.

content.subject: Catalog state dependencies in BA v11
content.description: Identify EVERY state-dependent filter/parameter in BA v11 stack: SV_TIGHT, overheat AVOID, D1 RE_BACKLOG state condition, cash_etf_states, anything inside simulate_holistic_nav.py that uses state_by_date.

content.subject: Build progressive strip variants
content.description: Build BA v11 variants that progressively remove state-deps: strip1 (no SV_TIGHT) → strip2 (no overheat) → strip3 (no D1 state) → strip4 (no cash_etf) → strip_clean (fully state-independent). Replace each removed state dep with state-free proxy.

content.subject: Cross-test strip variants × state series
content.description: Run integrated BA v11 with cross-product: (strip1, strip2, ..., strip_clean) × (TQ34b, DT_10_25_25). Find combination that: (a) maximizes state-independence, (b) achieves OOS performance ≥ TQ34b+full-state-deps baseline.

content.subject: Filter ablation analysis
content.description: Ablate each state-dependent filter individually to measure its marginal value. Identifies most/least impactful filters for tuning prioritization.

content.subject: Tune SV_TIGHT day thresholds
content.description: Sweep SV_TIGHT days_since_release thresholds per state: state 1→[15,30,45], state 2→[30,45,60,90], state 3→[30,45,60,90]. Find combination that improves OOS without overfitting IS.

content.subject: Tune AVOID_bear & overheat
content.description: Test (a) AVOID_bear with FA A/B-tier exempt (defensive stocks allowed in bear), (b) overheat broadened to state 4+5 with different Close/MA200 thresholds. Goal: better OOS risk management.

content.subject: Tune cash_etf parking
content.description: Sweep cash_etf_states: current {3:0.7}; test {2:0.3, 3:0.7}, {2:0.5, 3:0.7, 4:0.3}, {3:0.5} etc. Capture more idle cash productivity.

content.subject: Combined tuning + walk-forward
content.description: Test combinations of top OOS improvers: looser SVT + broader overheat + ETF in bear. Walk-forward validate. Best combo must beat V_PROD on OOS without IS overfit, with DD ≤ 22%.

content.subject: Cross-test filter × state series
content.description: 2×3 matrix: states {TQ34b, DT_10_25_25} × filters {V_PROD, C3_cons, C2_no_svt}. Does best filter tune cross-multiply with state tune, or do they conflict? Identify global optimum (state+filter combination).

content.subject: SVT lever refinement
content.description: Final refinement of SVT lever — test s3=120, s3=180, uniform tight, no-SVT alone, no-SVT+ETF. Find absolute sweet spot.

content.subject: Finalize production recommendation
content.description: Pick the production candidate based on refinement results. Write deployment summary + update MEMORY.md.

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test C3_cons
content.description: Run BA v11 pre-2014 sim (2007-2013) with C3_cons filters to verify cash_etf {2:0.5} doesn't destroy in 2008 GFC. Compare vs V_PROD pre-2014 baseline.

content.subject: Test C3_clean (no SVT) pre-2014
content.description: Verify removing SV_TIGHT entirely is safe pre-2014 (2007-2013). User insight: market matured, SVT was for immature pre-2014 era. Empirically validate before recommendation.

content.subject: V5 + DT integrated test
content.description: Test if DT_10_25_25 state-machine smoothing helps V5 (ETF_KELLY) integrated. Hypothesis: V5 more sensitive to state transitions than V11 (BAL) because 100% ETF parking amplifies transition friction. If yes, DT solves the noise problem for V5 specifically.

content.subject: Z1: V5 + DT + C3_clean combined
content.description: Test if filter tune (C3_clean = remove SVT) adds on top of state tune (DT_10_25_25) for V5 system. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ34b, DT} × filter {V_PROD, C3_clean}.

content.subject: Z2: V5+DT pre-2014 safety
content.description: Pre-2014 stress test for V5 + DT_10_25_25 integrated. Verify DT doesn't catastrophically fail 2008 GFC like cash_etf bear did. Single sim 2007-2013 with ETF_KELLY parking.

content.subject: B: V12.1 LAG + DT integrated
content.description: Test V12.1 architecture (BAL+LAGGED books) with DT_10_25_25 state smoothing. Plus ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD overlay. Goal: see if DT benefit transfers to V12.1's different book composition.

content.subject: C: Cross-architecture synthesis
content.description: Synthesize optimal stack across all dimensions: architecture (V11 vs V12.1), state (TQ vs DT), ensemble overlay, filter tune. Build final production recommendation matrix.

content.subject: V121_ENS + DT + C3_clean
content.description: Final untested combo: V12.1 ensemble + DT_10_25_25 state + C3_clean filter. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ, DT} × filter {V_PROD with Python SVT, C3_clean no SVT}. Determines if all 3 axes stack additively or conflict (like V11/V5).

content.subject: V5 V121_ENS+KELLY + DT test
content.description: Test V5 (V121_ENS architecture + ETF_KELLY) with DT_10_25_25 state. Hypothesis: KELLY amplifies state sensitivity like V11→V5 BAL did. Compare to canonical V5_TQ_KELLY ~26% per memory.

content.subject: Tổng hợp paper-trade versions
content.description: Tổng hợp 4 paper-trade systems đang chạy (pt_v11_tq34b, pt_v12_tq34b, pt_v12_live, pt_v121_ensemble) và recommend best state series từng version dựa trên 28-test research.

content.subject: Telegram report enhancement
content.description: Find 6PM Telegram report script, add DT_10_25_25 + TQ34b states section, add 5-system states from April 1 to report date.

content.subject: Remove pt_v12_live + rename versions
content.description: Remove pt_v12_live from paper-trade daily run + end-of-day report. Rename remaining versions to architecture-based names for memorability.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Paper-trade comparison report — 4 systems side-by-side.

Updated 2026-05-27:
  - Removed V3 (pt_v12_live) — alt state test no longer needed
  - Renamed to architecture-based names (V11 / V12 / V121_ENS / V121_Kelly)

Reads:
  data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv     (V11        = Song Sinh: BAL+VN30 + TQ34b)
  data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv     (V12        = Âm Dương: BAL+LAGGED + TQ34b)
  data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv      (V121_ENS   = V12.1 + Ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD + BASE)
  data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv   (V121_Kelly = V121_ENS + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0})

Plus VNINDEX from BQ for the same window as a passive benchmark.

Writes:
  data/papertrade_compare5.md    — markdown comparison report
  data/papertrade_compare5.csv   — daily NAV/return for all 4 + VNI
"""
import os, sys, io, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
sys.path.insert(0, WORKDIR)
os.chdir(WORKDIR)
from simulate_holistic_nav import bq

SYSTEMS = [
    ("V11",         "V11 Song Sinh (BAL+VN30) + TQ34b",          "data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V12",         "V12 Âm Dương (BAL+LAGGED) + TQ34b",         "data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_ENS",    "V12.1 Ensemble (M1+M3r AND-HOLD) + BASE",   "data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_Kelly",  "V12.1 Ensemble + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0}",     "data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv"),
]


def vni_series(start: str, end: str) -> pd.Series:
    df = bq(f"SELECT t.time, t.Close FROM tav2_bq.ticker AS t "
            f"WHERE t.ticker='VNINDEX' AND t.time BETWEEN DATE '{start}' AND DATE '{end}' "
            f"ORDER BY t.time")
    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])
    return df.set_index("time")["Close"]


def stats(nav: pd.Series) -> dict:
    nav = nav.dropna()
    if len(nav) < 2: return {}
    ret_total = nav.iloc[-1]/nav.iloc[0] - 1
    days = (nav.index[-1] - nav.index[0]).days
    years = days / 365.25
    cagr = (1+ret_total)**(1/years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0
    daily_ret = nav.pct_change().dropna()
    vol_ann = daily_ret.std() * np.sqrt(252)
    sharpe = (daily_ret.mean()*252)/vol_ann if vol_ann > 0 else 0
    peak = nav.cummax()
    dd = (nav-peak)/peak
    max_dd = dd.min()
    calmar = cagr/abs(max_dd) if max_dd < 0 else float("nan")
    return {"start": nav.index[0].date(), "end": nav.index[-1].date(),
            "days": days, "init": nav.iloc[0], "final": nav.iloc[-1],
            "ret_total": ret_total, "cagr": cagr, "vol_ann": vol_ann,
            "sharpe": sharpe, "max_dd": max_dd, "calmar": calmar}


def main():
    rows = {}
    nav_all = {}
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        full = os.path.join(WORKDIR, path)
        if not os.path.exists(full):
            print(f"  MISSING: {full}"); continue
        df = pd.read_csv(full, parse_dates=["ymd"]).sort_values("ymd")
        nav = df.set_index("ymd")["nav"]
        nav_all[key] = nav
        s = stats(nav); s["name"] = name; rows[key] = s

    if not rows:
        print("No logs found. Run pt_v11_tq34b.py / pt_v12_tq34b.py / pt_v12_live.py first.")
        return

    # VNI benchmark over same window
    first = min(s["start"] for s in rows.values())
    last  = max(s["end"]   for s in rows.values())
    try:
        vni = vni_series(first.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), last.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        # rebase to 50B at first day
        vni_nav = (vni / vni.iloc[0]) * 50e9
        nav_all["VNI_BH"] = vni_nav
        rows["VNI_BH"] = {**stats(vni_nav), "name": "VNINDEX Buy & Hold (rebased 50B)"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  VNI load failed: {e}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Write markdown
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    now = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    md = []
    md.append(f"# Paper-Trade Comparison — 5 Systems\n")
    md.append(f"*Generated: {now}*\n")
    md.append(f"*Window: {first} → {last} ({(last-first).days} calendar days)*\n")
    md.append(f"*Init NAV: 50B VND fresh, all-cash, no positions (each system)*\n\n")

    md.append("## Headline metrics\n")
    md.append("| System | Final NAV | Total Ret | CAGR | Vol (ann) | Sharpe | Max DD | Calmar |")
    md.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    keys_order = ["V1_V11_TQ34b","V2_V12_TQ34b","V3_V12_LIVE","V4_V121_ENS","V5_V121_ENS_Q2","VNI_BH"]
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        md.append(f"| **{s['name']}** | {s['final']/1e9:.3f}B | "
                  f"{s['ret_total']*100:+.2f}% | {s['cagr']*100:+.2f}% | "
                  f"{s['vol_ann']*100:.2f}% | {s['sharpe']:+.2f} | "
                  f"{s['max_dd']*100:+.2f}% | {s['calmar']:+.2f} |")
    md.append("")

    # Delta vs V4_V121_ENS (leading backtest winner, baseline for V5 Q2 overlay)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows:
        ref_ret = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["ret_total"]
        ref_dd  = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["max_dd"]
        md.append("## Delta vs V4 V121_ENS (backtest winner baseline)\n")
        md.append("| System | ΔRet | ΔDD | Verdict |")
        md.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for k in ["V1_V11_TQ34b","V2_V12_TQ34b","V3_V12_LIVE","V5_V121_ENS_Q2","VNI_BH"]:
            if k not in rows: continue
            s = rows[k]
            dret = (s["ret_total"] - ref_ret) * 100
            ddd  = (s["max_dd"] - ref_dd) * 100
            verdict = ("Both better" if dret > 0 and ddd > 0
                       else "Return better, DD worse" if dret > 0
                       else "DD better, return worse" if ddd > 0
                       else "Both worse")
            md.append(f"| {s['name']} | {dret:+.2f}pp | {ddd:+.2f}pp | {verdict} |")
        md.append("")

    # V5 vs V4 (Kelly Q2 overlay watch — V5 expected to beat V4 by +1-4pp OOS in backtest)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows and "V5_V121_ENS_Q2" in rows:
        v4 = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]; v5 = rows["V5_V121_ENS_Q2"]
        d_ret = (v5["ret_total"] - v4["ret_total"]) * 100
        d_dd  = (v5["max_dd"] - v4["max_dd"]) * 100
        d_sh  = v5["sharpe"] - v4["sharpe"]
        md.append("## V5 (Kelly Q2 overlay) vs V4 (baseline ensemble) — KEY WATCH\n")
        md.append(f"- ΔRet  = **{d_ret:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: +1pp FULL / +4pp OOS)")
        md.append(f"- ΔDD   = **{d_dd:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: -4pp wider; gate: ≥ -6pp)")
        md.append(f"- ΔShar = **{d_sh:+.2f}**    (backtest expectation: ≈ flat or slight improvement)")
        gate = "🟢 GREEN" if (d_ret > -1 and d_dd > -6) else "🟡 YELLOW" if d_dd > -8 else "🔴 RED"
        md.append(f"- Gate verdict: **{gate}**")
        md.append("")

    # NAV curve snapshot every ~10 days
    md.append("## Weekly NAV snapshot (every ~5 trading days)\n")
    all_dates = sorted(set().union(*[set(nav.index) for nav in nav_all.values()]))
    snap_dates = all_dates[::5] + [all_dates[-1]]
    snap_dates = sorted(set(snap_dates))
    cols = ["Date"] + [rows[k]["name"] for k in keys_order if k in rows]
    md.append("| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |")
    md.append("|" + "|".join(["---"]*len(cols)) + "|")
    for d in snap_dates:
        row = [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")]
        for k in keys_order:
            if k not in nav_all: continue
            v = nav_all[k].asof(d)
            row.append(f"{v/1e9:.2f}B" if pd.notna(v) else "—")
        md.append("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |")
    md.append("")

    md.append("## Files\n")
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        md.append(f"- `{path}` — {name}")
    md.append(f"- `data/papertrade_compare5.csv` — daily NAV all systems\n")

    out_md = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.md")
    with open(out_md, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(md))
    print(f"Wrote {out_md}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CSV with daily NAV all systems
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_d = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.DatetimeIndex(all_dates))
    for k, nav in nav_all.items():
        all_d[k] = nav.reindex(all_d.index).ffill()
    all_d.index.name = "ymd"
    out_csv = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.csv")
    all_d.to_csv(out_csv)
    print(f"Wrote {out_csv}")

    # Console summary
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print(" PAPER-TRADE COMPARISON")
    print("="*80)
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        print(f" {s['name']:<40} ret {s['ret_total']*100:+6.2f}%  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:+6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_dd']*100:+6.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:+.2f}  Calmar {s['calmar']:+.2f}")
    print("="*80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv     (V12        = Âm Dương: BAL+LAGGED + TQ34b)
  data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv      (V121_ENS   = V12.1 + Ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD + BASE)
  data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv   (V121_Kelly = V121_ENS + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0})

Plus VNINDEX from BQ for the same window as a passive benchmark.

Writes:
  data/papertrade_compare5.md    — markdown comparison report
  data/papertrade_compare5.csv   — daily NAV/return for all 4 + VNI
"""
import os, sys, io, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
sys.path.insert(0, WORKDIR)
os.chdir(WORKDIR)
from simulate_holistic_nav import bq

SYSTEMS = [
    ("V11",         "V11 Song Sinh (BAL+VN30) + TQ34b",          "data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V12",         "V12 Âm Dương (BAL+LAGGED) + TQ34b",         "data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_ENS",    "V12.1 Ensemble (M1+M3r AND-HOLD) + BASE",   "data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_Kelly",  "V12.1 Ensemble + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0}",     "data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv"),
]


def vni_series(start: str, end: str) -> pd.Series:
    df = bq(f"SELECT t.time, t.Close FROM tav2_bq.ticker AS t "
            f"WHERE t.ticker='VNINDEX' AND t.time BETWEEN DATE '{start}' AND DATE '{end}' "
            f"ORDER BY t.time")
    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])
    return df.set_index("time")["Close"]


def stats(nav: pd.Series) -> dict:
    nav = nav.dropna()
    if len(nav) < 2: return {}
    ret_total = nav.iloc[-1]/nav.iloc[0] - 1
    days = (nav.index[-1] - nav.index[0]).days
    years = days / 365.25
    cagr = (1+ret_total)**(1/years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0
    daily_ret = nav.pct_change().dropna()
    vol_ann = daily_ret.std() * np.sqrt(252)
    sharpe = (daily_ret.mean()*252)/vol_ann if vol_ann > 0 else 0
    peak = nav.cummax()
    dd = (nav-peak)/peak
    max_dd = dd.min()
    calmar = cagr/abs(max_dd) if max_dd < 0 else float("nan")
    return {"start": nav.index[0].date(), "end": nav.index[-1].date(),
            "days": days, "init": nav.iloc[0], "final": nav.iloc[-1],
            "ret_total": ret_total, "cagr": cagr, "vol_ann": vol_ann,
            "sharpe": sharpe, "max_dd": max_dd, "calmar": calmar}


def main():
    rows = {}
    nav_all = {}
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        full = os.path.join(WORKDIR, path)
        if not os.path.exists(full):
            print(f"  MISSING: {full}"); continue
        df = pd.read_csv(full, parse_dates=["ymd"]).sort_values("ymd")
        nav = df.set_index("ymd")["nav"]
        nav_all[key] = nav
        s = stats(nav); s["name"] = name; rows[key] = s

    if not rows:
        print("No logs found. Run pt_v11_tq34b.py / pt_v12_tq34b.py / pt_v12_live.py first.")
        return

    # VNI benchmark over same window
    first = min(s["start"] for s in rows.values())
    last  = max(s["end"]   for s in rows.values())
    try:
        vni = vni_series(first.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), last.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        # rebase to 50B at first day
        vni_nav = (vni / vni.iloc[0]) * 50e9
        nav_all["VNI_BH"] = vni_nav
        rows["VNI_BH"] = {**stats(vni_nav), "name": "VNINDEX Buy & Hold (rebased 50B)"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  VNI load failed: {e}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Write markdown
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    now = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    md = []
    md.append(f"# Paper-Trade Comparison — 5 Systems\n")
    md.append(f"*Generated: {now}*\n")
    md.append(f"*Window: {first} → {last} ({(last-first).days} calendar days)*\n")
    md.append(f"*Init NAV: 50B VND fresh, all-cash, no positions (each system)*\n\n")

    md.append("## Headline metrics\n")
    md.append("| System | Final NAV | Total Ret | CAGR | Vol (ann) | Sharpe | Max DD | Calmar |")
    md.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    keys_order = ["V11","V12","V121_ENS","V121_Kelly","VNI_BH"]
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        md.append(f"| **{s['name']}** | {s['final']/1e9:.3f}B | "
                  f"{s['ret_total']*100:+.2f}% | {s['cagr']*100:+.2f}% | "
                  f"{s['vol_ann']*100:.2f}% | {s['sharpe']:+.2f} | "
                  f"{s['max_dd']*100:+.2f}% | {s['calmar']:+.2f} |")
    md.append("")

    # Delta vs V4_V121_ENS (leading backtest winner, baseline for V5 Q2 overlay)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows:
        ref_ret = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["ret_total"]
        ref_dd  = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]["max_dd"]
        md.append("## Delta vs V4 V121_ENS (backtest winner baseline)\n")
        md.append("| System | ΔRet | ΔDD | Verdict |")
        md.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for k in ["V1_V11_TQ34b","V2_V12_TQ34b","V3_V12_LIVE","V5_V121_ENS_Q2","VNI_BH"]:
            if k not in rows: continue
            s = rows[k]
            dret = (s["ret_total"] - ref_ret) * 100
            ddd  = (s["max_dd"] - ref_dd) * 100
            verdict = ("Both better" if dret > 0 and ddd > 0
                       else "Return better, DD worse" if dret > 0
                       else "DD better, return worse" if ddd > 0
                       else "Both worse")
            md.append(f"| {s['name']} | {dret:+.2f}pp | {ddd:+.2f}pp | {verdict} |")
        md.append("")

    # V5 vs V4 (Kelly Q2 overlay watch — V5 expected to beat V4 by +1-4pp OOS in backtest)
    if "V4_V121_ENS" in rows and "V5_V121_ENS_Q2" in rows:
        v4 = rows["V4_V121_ENS"]; v5 = rows["V5_V121_ENS_Q2"]
        d_ret = (v5["ret_total"] - v4["ret_total"]) * 100
        d_dd  = (v5["max_dd"] - v4["max_dd"]) * 100
        d_sh  = v5["sharpe"] - v4["sharpe"]
        md.append("## V5 (Kelly Q2 overlay) vs V4 (baseline ensemble) — KEY WATCH\n")
        md.append(f"- ΔRet  = **{d_ret:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: +1pp FULL / +4pp OOS)")
        md.append(f"- ΔDD   = **{d_dd:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: -4pp wider; gate: ≥ -6pp)")
        md.append(f"- ΔShar = **{d_sh:+.2f}**    (backtest expectation: ≈ flat or slight improvement)")
        gate = "🟢 GREEN" if (d_ret > -1 and d_dd > -6) else "🟡 YELLOW" if d_dd > -8 else "🔴 RED"
        md.append(f"- Gate verdict: **{gate}**")
        md.append("")

    # NAV curve snapshot every ~10 days
    md.append("## Weekly NAV snapshot (every ~5 trading days)\n")
    all_dates = sorted(set().union(*[set(nav.index) for nav in nav_all.values()]))
    snap_dates = all_dates[::5] + [all_dates[-1]]
    snap_dates = sorted(set(snap_dates))
    cols = ["Date"] + [rows[k]["name"] for k in keys_order if k in rows]
    md.append("| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |")
    md.append("|" + "|".join(["---"]*len(cols)) + "|")
    for d in snap_dates:
        row = [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")]
        for k in keys_order:
            if k not in nav_all: continue
            v = nav_all[k].asof(d)
            row.append(f"{v/1e9:.2f}B" if pd.notna(v) else "—")
        md.append("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |")
    md.append("")

    md.append("## Files\n")
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        md.append(f"- `{path}` — {name}")
    md.append(f"- `data/papertrade_compare5.csv` — daily NAV all systems\n")

    out_md = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.md")
    with open(out_md, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(md))
    print(f"Wrote {out_md}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CSV with daily NAV all systems
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_d = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.DatetimeIndex(all_dates))
    for k, nav in nav_all.items():
        all_d[k] = nav.reindex(all_d.index).ffill()
    all_d.index.name = "ymd"
    out_csv = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.csv")
    all_d.to_csv(out_csv)
    print(f"Wrote {out_csv}")

    # Console summary
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print(" PAPER-TRADE COMPARISON")
    print("="*80)
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        print(f" {s['name']:<40} ret {s['ret_total']*100:+6.2f}%  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:+6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_dd']*100:+6.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:+.2f}  Calmar {s['calmar']:+.2f}")
    print("="*80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest
content.description: Locate and run BA v11 production backtest with new state series substituted. Critical because state-machine standalone wins don't [REDACTED] transfer (v2g lesson: +1.28pp standalone but -2.40pp integrated). Compare canonical TQ34b vs new variant on full BA v11 stack.

content.subject: Catalog state dependencies in BA v11
content.description: Identify EVERY state-dependent filter/parameter in BA v11 stack: SV_TIGHT, overheat AVOID, D1 RE_BACKLOG state condition, cash_etf_states, anything inside simulate_holistic_nav.py that uses state_by_date.

content.subject: Build progressive strip variants
content.description: Build BA v11 variants that progressively remove state-deps: strip1 (no SV_TIGHT) → strip2 (no overheat) → strip3 (no D1 state) → strip4 (no cash_etf) → strip_clean (fully state-independent). Replace each removed state dep with state-free proxy.

content.subject: Cross-test strip variants × state series
content.description: Run integrated BA v11 with cross-product: (strip1, strip2, ..., strip_clean) × (TQ34b, DT_10_25_25). Find combination that: (a) maximizes state-independence, (b) achieves OOS performance ≥ TQ34b+full-state-deps baseline.

content.subject: Filter ablation analysis
content.description: Ablate each state-dependent filter individually to measure its marginal value. Identifies most/least impactful filters for tuning prioritization.

content.subject: Tune SV_TIGHT day thresholds
content.description: Sweep SV_TIGHT days_since_release thresholds per state: state 1→[15,30,45], state 2→[30,45,60,90], state 3→[30,45,60,90]. Find combination that improves OOS without overfitting IS.

content.subject: Tune AVOID_bear & overheat
content.description: Test (a) AVOID_bear with FA A/B-tier exempt (defensive stocks allowed in bear), (b) overheat broadened to state 4+5 with different Close/MA200 thresholds. Goal: better OOS risk management.

content.subject: Tune cash_etf parking
content.description: Sweep cash_etf_states: current {3:0.7}; test {2:0.3, 3:0.7}, {2:0.5, 3:0.7, 4:0.3}, {3:0.5} etc. Capture more idle cash productivity.

content.subject: Combined tuning + walk-forward
content.description: Test combinations of top OOS improvers: looser SVT + broader overheat + ETF in bear. Walk-forward validate. Best combo must beat V_PROD on OOS without IS overfit, with DD ≤ 22%.

content.subject: Cross-test filter × state series
content.description: 2×3 matrix: states {TQ34b, DT_10_25_25} × filters {V_PROD, C3_cons, C2_no_svt}. Does best filter tune cross-multiply with state tune, or do they conflict? Identify global optimum (state+filter combination).

content.subject: SVT lever refinement
content.description: Final refinement of SVT lever — test s3=120, s3=180, uniform tight, no-SVT alone, no-SVT+ETF. Find absolute sweet spot.

content.subject: Finalize production recommendation

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test C3_cons

content.subject: Test C3_clean (no SVT) pre-2014

content.subject: Z2: V5+DT pre-2014 safety

content.subject: B: V12.1 LAG + DT integrated

content.subject: C: Cross-architecture synthesis
content.description: Synthesize optimal stack across all dimensions: architecture (V11 vs V12.1), state (TQ vs DT), ensemble overlay, filter tune. Build final production recommendation matrix.

content.subject: V121_ENS + DT + C3_clean

content.subject: V5 V121_ENS+KELLY + DT test

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Auto-detect safe END_DATE for paper-trade sims.

Returns min of (today-1, lagged_pos_ov max, 5state max, BQ ticker max).
intraday_full.pkl is NOT a hard cap — sim falls back to T+1 Open when missing.
"""
import os, pickle
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
START_DATE = "2026-04-01"  # paper-trade window start (canonical)


def detect_end_date(bq_check=False) -> str:
    cands = [pd.Timestamp(datetime.now().date()) - pd.Timedelta(days=1)]
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(WORKDIR, "lagged_pos_ov.pkl"), "rb") as f:
            ov = pickle.load(f)
        cands.append(pd.to_datetime(ov["time"]).max())
    except Exception:
        pass
    if bq_check:
        try:
            import subprocess
            r = subprocess.run(
                ["bq", "query", "--use_legacy_sql=false",
                 "--project_id=[REDACTED]", "--format=csv",
                 "SELECT MAX(s.time) FROM tav2_bq.vnindex_5state AS s"],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
            lines = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("f0_")]
            if lines:
                cands.append(pd.Timestamp(lines[0]))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return min(cands).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"START_DATE={START_DATE}")
    print(f"END_DATE={detect_end_date(bq_check=True)}")

"""Auto-detect safe END_DATE for paper-trade sims.

Returns min of (today-1, lagged_pos_ov max, 5state max, BQ ticker max).
intraday_full.pkl is NOT a hard cap — sim falls back to T+1 Open when missing.
"""
import os, pickle
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
START_DATE = "2026-04-01"  # paper-trade window start (canonical)


def detect_end_date(bq_check=False) -> str:
    cands = [pd.Timestamp(datetime.now().date()) - pd.Timedelta(days=1)]
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(WORKDIR, "lagged_pos_ov.pkl"), "rb") as f:
            ov = pickle.load(f)
        cands.append(pd.to_datetime(ov["time"]).max())
    except Exception:
        pass
    if bq_check:
        try:
            import subprocess
            r = subprocess.run(
                ["bq", "query", "--use_legacy_sql=false",
                 "--project_id=[REDACTED]", "--format=csv",
                 "SELECT MAX(s.time) FROM tav2_bq.vnindex_5state AS s"],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
            lines = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("f0_")]
            if lines:
                cands.append(pd.Timestamp(lines[0]))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return min(cands).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"START_DATE={START_DATE}")
    print(f"END_DATE={detect_end_date(bq_check=True)}")

content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest

# ── DT_10_25_25 = causal asymmetric confirmation applied to TQ34b ──
# Pull FULL TQ34b history (2014+) to ensure DT algorithm has proper warmup,
# then filter to paper-trade window.
def _dt_causal_asym(states_arr, default_min=10, crisis_min=25, exbull_min=25):
    """Apply causal asymmetric confirmation. Commits new state only after
    N consecutive days of agreement. CRISIS(1)/EX-BULL(5) need 25d, others 10d."""
    target_min = {1: crisis_min, 5: exbull_min}
    out = states_arr.copy()
    committed = states_arr[0]
    pending_state = states_arr[0]
    pending_run = 1
    out[0] = committed
    for t in range(1, len(states_arr)):
        s = states_arr[t]
        if s == pending_state:
            pending_run += 1
        else:
            pending_state = s
            pending_run = 1
        need = target_min.get(pending_state, default_min)
        if pending_run >= need and pending_state != committed:
            committed = pending_state
        out[t] = committed
    return out

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Paper-trade comparison report — 4 systems side-by-side.

Updated 2026-05-27:
  - Removed V3 (pt_v12_live) — alt state test no longer needed
  - Renamed to architecture-based names (V11 / V12 / V121_ENS / V121_Kelly)

Reads:
  data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv     (V11        = Song Sinh: BAL+VN30 + TQ34b)
  data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv     (V12        = Âm Dương: BAL+LAGGED + TQ34b)
  data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv      (V121_ENS   = V12.1 + Ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD + BASE)
  data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv   (V121_Kelly = V121_ENS + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0})

Plus VNINDEX from BQ for the same window as a passive benchmark.

Writes:
  data/papertrade_compare5.md    — markdown comparison report
  data/papertrade_compare5.csv   — daily NAV/return for all 4 + VNI
"""
import os, sys, io, datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
WORKDIR = r"/home/trido/thanhdt/WorkingClaude"
sys.path.insert(0, WORKDIR)
os.chdir(WORKDIR)
from simulate_holistic_nav import bq

SYSTEMS = [
    ("V11",         "V11 Song Sinh (BAL+VN30) + TQ34b",          "data/pt_v11_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V12",         "V12 Âm Dương (BAL+LAGGED) + TQ34b",         "data/pt_v12_tq34b_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_ENS",    "V12.1 Ensemble (M1+M3r AND-HOLD) + BASE",   "data/pt_v121_ens_logs.csv"),
    ("V121_Kelly",  "V12.1 Ensemble + Kelly NEUTRAL{3:1.0}",     "data/pt_v121_ens_q2_logs.csv"),
]


def vni_series(start: str, end: str) -> pd.Series:
    df = bq(f"SELECT t.time, t.Close FROM tav2_bq.ticker AS t "
            f"WHERE t.ticker='VNINDEX' AND t.time BETWEEN DATE '{start}' AND DATE '{end}' "
            f"ORDER BY t.time")
    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])
    return df.set_index("time")["Close"]


def stats(nav: pd.Series) -> dict:
    nav = nav.dropna()
    if len(nav) < 2: return {}
    ret_total = nav.iloc[-1]/nav.iloc[0] - 1
    days = (nav.index[-1] - nav.index[0]).days
    years = days / 365.25
    cagr = (1+ret_total)**(1/years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0
    daily_ret = nav.pct_change().dropna()
    vol_ann = daily_ret.std() * np.sqrt(252)
    sharpe = (daily_ret.mean()*252)/vol_ann if vol_ann > 0 else 0
    peak = nav.cummax()
    dd = (nav-peak)/peak
    max_dd = dd.min()
    calmar = cagr/abs(max_dd) if max_dd < 0 else float("nan")
    return {"start": nav.index[0].date(), "end": nav.index[-1].date(),
            "days": days, "init": nav.iloc[0], "final": nav.iloc[-1],
            "ret_total": ret_total, "cagr": cagr, "vol_ann": vol_ann,
            "sharpe": sharpe, "max_dd": max_dd, "calmar": calmar}


def main():
    rows = {}
    nav_all = {}
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        full = os.path.join(WORKDIR, path)
        if not os.path.exists(full):
            print(f"  MISSING: {full}"); continue
        df = pd.read_csv(full, parse_dates=["ymd"]).sort_values("ymd")
        nav = df.set_index("ymd")["nav"]
        nav_all[key] = nav
        s = stats(nav); s["name"] = name; rows[key] = s

    if not rows:
        print("No logs found. Run pt_v11_tq34b.py / pt_v12_tq34b.py / pt_v12_live.py first.")
        return

    # VNI benchmark over same window
    first = min(s["start"] for s in rows.values())
    last  = max(s["end"]   for s in rows.values())
    try:
        vni = vni_series(first.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), last.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        # rebase to 50B at first day
        vni_nav = (vni / vni.iloc[0]) * 50e9
        nav_all["VNI_BH"] = vni_nav
        rows["VNI_BH"] = {**stats(vni_nav), "name": "VNINDEX Buy & Hold (rebased 50B)"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  VNI load failed: {e}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Write markdown
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    now = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    md = []
    md.append(f"# Paper-Trade Comparison — 5 Systems\n")
    md.append(f"*Generated: {now}*\n")
    md.append(f"*Window: {first} → {last} ({(last-first).days} calendar days)*\n")
    md.append(f"*Init NAV: 50B VND fresh, all-cash, no positions (each system)*\n\n")

    md.append("## Headline metrics\n")
    md.append("| System | Final NAV | Total Ret | CAGR | Vol (ann) | Sharpe | Max DD | Calmar |")
    md.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    keys_order = ["V11","V12","V121_ENS","V121_Kelly","VNI_BH"]
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        md.append(f"| **{s['name']}** | {s['final']/1e9:.3f}B | "
                  f"{s['ret_total']*100:+.2f}% | {s['cagr']*100:+.2f}% | "
                  f"{s['vol_ann']*100:.2f}% | {s['sharpe']:+.2f} | "
                  f"{s['max_dd']*100:+.2f}% | {s['calmar']:+.2f} |")
    md.append("")

    # Delta vs V121_ENS (leading backtest winner, baseline for Kelly overlay)
    if "V121_ENS" in rows:
        ref_ret = rows["V121_ENS"]["ret_total"]
        ref_dd  = rows["V121_ENS"]["max_dd"]
        md.append("## Delta vs V121_ENS (backtest winner baseline)\n")
        md.append("| System | ΔRet | ΔDD | Verdict |")
        md.append("|---|---|---|---|")
        for k in ["V11","V12","V121_Kelly","VNI_BH"]:
            if k not in rows: continue
            s = rows[k]
            dret = (s["ret_total"] - ref_ret) * 100
            ddd  = (s["max_dd"] - ref_dd) * 100
            verdict = ("Both better" if dret > 0 and ddd > 0
                       else "Return better, DD worse" if dret > 0
                       else "DD better, return worse" if ddd > 0
                       else "Both worse")
            md.append(f"| {s['name']} | {dret:+.2f}pp | {ddd:+.2f}pp | {verdict} |")
        md.append("")

    # V121_Kelly vs V121_ENS (Kelly overlay watch — expected to beat by +1-4pp OOS in backtest)
    if "V121_ENS" in rows and "V121_Kelly" in rows:
        ref = rows["V121_ENS"]; ke = rows["V121_Kelly"]
        d_ret = (ke["ret_total"] - ref["ret_total"]) * 100
        d_dd  = (ke["max_dd"] - ref["max_dd"]) * 100
        d_sh  = ke["sharpe"] - ref["sharpe"]
        md.append("## V121_Kelly vs V121_ENS (Kelly overlay) — KEY WATCH\n")
        md.append(f"- ΔRet  = **{d_ret:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: +1pp FULL / +4pp OOS)")
        md.append(f"- ΔDD   = **{d_dd:+.2f}pp**  (backtest expectation: -4pp wider; gate: ≥ -6pp)")
        md.append(f"- ΔShar = **{d_sh:+.2f}**    (backtest expectation: ≈ flat or slight improvement)")
        gate = "🟢 GREEN" if (d_ret > -1 and d_dd > -6) else "🟡 YELLOW" if d_dd > -8 else "🔴 RED"
        md.append(f"- Gate verdict: **{gate}**")
        md.append("")

    # NAV curve snapshot every ~10 days
    md.append("## Weekly NAV snapshot (every ~5 trading days)\n")
    all_dates = sorted(set().union(*[set(nav.index) for nav in nav_all.values()]))
    snap_dates = all_dates[::5] + [all_dates[-1]]
    snap_dates = sorted(set(snap_dates))
    cols = ["Date"] + [rows[k]["name"] for k in keys_order if k in rows]
    md.append("| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |")
    md.append("|" + "|".join(["---"]*len(cols)) + "|")
    for d in snap_dates:
        row = [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")]
        for k in keys_order:
            if k not in nav_all: continue
            v = nav_all[k].asof(d)
            row.append(f"{v/1e9:.2f}B" if pd.notna(v) else "—")
        md.append("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |")
    md.append("")

    md.append("## Files\n")
    for key, name, path in SYSTEMS:
        md.append(f"- `{path}` — {name}")
    md.append(f"- `data/papertrade_compare5.csv` — daily NAV all systems\n")

    out_md = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.md")
    with open(out_md, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(md))
    print(f"Wrote {out_md}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CSV with daily NAV all systems
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_d = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.DatetimeIndex(all_dates))
    for k, nav in nav_all.items():
        all_d[k] = nav.reindex(all_d.index).ffill()
    all_d.index.name = "ymd"
    out_csv = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "data", "papertrade_compare5.csv")
    all_d.to_csv(out_csv)
    print(f"Wrote {out_csv}")

    # Console summary
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print(" PAPER-TRADE COMPARISON")
    print("="*80)
    for k in keys_order:
        if k not in rows: continue
        s = rows[k]
        print(f" {s['name']:<40} ret {s['ret_total']*100:+6.2f}%  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:+6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_dd']*100:+6.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:+.2f}  Calmar {s['calmar']:+.2f}")
    print("="*80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest
content.description: Locate and run BA v11 production backtest with new state series substituted. Critical because state-machine standalone wins don't [REDACTED] transfer (v2g lesson: +1.28pp standalone but -2.40pp integrated). Compare canonical TQ34b vs new variant on full BA v11 stack.

content.subject: Catalog state dependencies in BA v11
content.description: Identify EVERY state-dependent filter/parameter in BA v11 stack: SV_TIGHT, overheat AVOID, D1 RE_BACKLOG state condition, cash_etf_states, anything inside simulate_holistic_nav.py that uses state_by_date.

content.subject: Build progressive strip variants
content.description: Build BA v11 variants that progressively remove state-deps: strip1 (no SV_TIGHT) → strip2 (no overheat) → strip3 (no D1 state) → strip4 (no cash_etf) → strip_clean (fully state-independent). Replace each removed state dep with state-free proxy.

content.subject: Cross-test strip variants × state series
content.description: Run integrated BA v11 with cross-product: (strip1, strip2, ..., strip_clean) × (TQ34b, DT_10_25_25). Find combination that: (a) maximizes state-independence, (b) achieves OOS performance ≥ TQ34b+full-state-deps baseline.

content.subject: Filter ablation analysis
content.description: Ablate each state-dependent filter individually to measure its marginal value. Identifies most/least impactful filters for tuning prioritization.

content.subject: Tune SV_TIGHT day thresholds
content.description: Sweep SV_TIGHT days_since_release thresholds per state: state 1→[15,30,45], state 2→[30,45,60,90], state 3→[30,45,60,90]. Find combination that improves OOS without overfitting IS.

content.subject: Tune AVOID_bear & overheat
content.description: Test (a) AVOID_bear with FA A/B-tier exempt (defensive stocks allowed in bear), (b) overheat broadened to state 4+5 with different Close/MA200 thresholds. Goal: better OOS risk management.

content.subject: Tune cash_etf parking
content.description: Sweep cash_etf_states: current {3:0.7}; test {2:0.3, 3:0.7}, {2:0.5, 3:0.7, 4:0.3}, {3:0.5} etc. Capture more idle cash productivity.

content.subject: Combined tuning + walk-forward
content.description: Test combinations of top OOS improvers: looser SVT + broader overheat + ETF in bear. Walk-forward validate. Best combo must beat V_PROD on OOS without IS overfit, with DD ≤ 22%.

content.subject: Cross-test filter × state series
content.description: 2×3 matrix: states {TQ34b, DT_10_25_25} × filters {V_PROD, C3_cons, C2_no_svt}. Does best filter tune cross-multiply with state tune, or do they conflict? Identify global optimum (state+filter combination).

content.subject: SVT lever refinement
content.description: Final refinement of SVT lever — test s3=120, s3=180, uniform tight, no-SVT alone, no-SVT+ETF. Find absolute sweet spot.

content.subject: Finalize production recommendation
content.description: Pick the production candidate based on refinement results. Write deployment summary + update MEMORY.md.

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test C3_cons
content.description: Run BA v11 pre-2014 sim (2007-2013) with C3_cons filters to verify cash_etf {2:0.5} doesn't destroy in 2008 GFC. Compare vs V_PROD pre-2014 baseline.

content.subject: Test C3_clean (no SVT) pre-2014
content.description: Verify removing SV_TIGHT entirely is safe pre-2014 (2007-2013). User insight: market matured, SVT was for immature pre-2014 era. Empirically validate before recommendation.

content.subject: V5 + DT integrated test
content.description: Test if DT_10_25_25 state-machine smoothing helps V5 (ETF_KELLY) integrated. Hypothesis: V5 more sensitive to state transitions than V11 (BAL) because 100% ETF parking amplifies transition friction. If yes, DT solves the noise problem for V5 specifically.

content.subject: Z1: V5 + DT + C3_clean combined
content.description: Test if filter tune (C3_clean = remove SVT) adds on top of state tune (DT_10_25_25) for V5 system. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ34b, DT} × filter {V_PROD, C3_clean}.

content.subject: Z2: V5+DT pre-2014 safety
content.description: Pre-2014 stress test for V5 + DT_10_25_25 integrated. Verify DT doesn't catastrophically fail 2008 GFC like cash_etf bear did. Single sim 2007-2013 with ETF_KELLY parking.

content.subject: B: V12.1 LAG + DT integrated
content.description: Test V12.1 architecture (BAL+LAGGED books) with DT_10_25_25 state smoothing. Plus ensemble M1+M3r AND-HOLD overlay. Goal: see if DT benefit transfers to V12.1's different book composition.

content.subject: C: Cross-architecture synthesis
content.description: Synthesize optimal stack across all dimensions: architecture (V11 vs V12.1), state (TQ vs DT), ensemble overlay, filter tune. Build final production recommendation matrix.

content.subject: V121_ENS + DT + C3_clean
content.description: Final untested combo: V12.1 ensemble + DT_10_25_25 state + C3_clean filter. 2x2 matrix: state {TQ, DT} × filter {V_PROD with Python SVT, C3_clean no SVT}. Determines if all 3 axes stack additively or conflict (like V11/V5).

content.subject: V5 V121_ENS+KELLY + DT test
content.description: Test V5 (V121_ENS architecture + ETF_KELLY) with DT_10_25_25 state. Hypothesis: KELLY amplifies state sensitivity like V11→V5 BAL did. Compare to canonical V5_TQ_KELLY ~26% per memory.

content.subject: Tổng hợp paper-trade versions
content.description: Tổng hợp 4 paper-trade systems đang chạy (pt_v11_tq34b, pt_v12_tq34b, pt_v12_live, pt_v121_ensemble) và recommend best state series từng version dựa trên 28-test research.

content.subject: Telegram report enhancement
content.description: Find 6PM Telegram report script, add DT_10_25_25 + TQ34b states section, add 5-system states from April 1 to report date.

content.subject: Remove pt_v12_live + rename versions
content.description: Remove pt_v12_live from paper-trade daily run + end-of-day report. Rename remaining versions to architecture-based names for memorability.

content.subject: Upgrade V11 paper-trade to KELLY+DT
content.description: Replace pt_v11_tq34b config: ETF_BASE→KELLY {3:1.0}, state TQ34b→DT_10_25_25. Validated +1.90pp Full CAGR / +1.83pp OOS / DD -24.5% better than -27.4%.

```

Stack: V11 + SV_TIGHT + P3 + RE_BACKLOG + KELLY ETF{3:1.0} + DT_10_25_25 state
```

**1. DT computation worked correctly ✅**
```
Paper-trade window 2026-04-01 -> 2026-05-19:
TQ34b transitions: 2 | DT_10_25_25 transitions: 0 (-2)
```
- TQ34b: 2 transitions (CRISIS→BEAR Apr 3, BEAR→NEUTRAL Apr 13)
- DT_10_25_25: **0 transitions** (stayed NEUTRAL throughout — 25d confirm filtered out brief CRISIS)
- ✅ -100% transition reduction in test window

**2. KELLY ETF active ✅**
- Final allocation: cash 0.54B + **ETF 43.36B** + stocks 11.24B
- ETF = 78.6% of NAV (KELLY 100% idle parking in NEUTRAL)
- Compare nếu BASE: ETF would be ~30B (60% NAV)

**3. Pipeline integrity ✅**
- Reconciliation passed (Actual end cash matches expected from transactions trail)
- Final NAV: 55.14B = cash (0.54B) + ETF (43.36B) + stocks (11.24B) ✓
- All 4 CSV outputs generated: logs, transactions, open_positions, report.md

| Metric | Result |
|--------|--------|
| Initial NAV | 50.00B |
| **Final NAV** | **55.14B** |

### Mechanism observed live

**E1VFVN30 ETF parking benefit:**
- April 1: DT committed NEUTRAL from prior history → KELLY {3:1.0} → 100% idle → buy E1VFVN30
- Held entire period: **+9.96% gain** on largest ETF position (22.50B → 24.75B)
- Total ETF unrealized: +3.66B

**If TQ34b was used (counterfactual):**
- April 1-2: TQ34b = CRISIS → no ETF parking, cash idle
- April 3-12: TQ34b = BEAR → no ETF parking
- April 13: TQ34b = NEUTRAL → start ETF buying
- Would have missed initial ~3% of E1VFVN30 gain (12-day delay)

**DT_10_25_25 captures earlier NEUTRAL recovery** — confirmed live in this short window.

- **Overheat blocks 0**: No VNI overheat in Apr-May 2026 (no state 5 nor extreme MA200 distance)

content.subject: Diagnose TQ34b transition behavior
content.description: Post-2014 deep dive: per-year transition counts, stay-duration distribution, which state-pair transitions are most frequent, identify problematic rapid flips (esp. BULL↔EX-BULL, NEUTRAL↔BEAR oscillations). Output baseline metrics.

content.subject: Realistic TC sensitivity baseline
content.description: Simulate TQ34b at TC = 0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/1.0% to establish how much current strategy loses to realistic friction. This is the metric for evaluating "fewer transitions" variants — a stable variant should win at TC=0.3% even if slightly behind at TC=0.1%.

content.subject: Build stability-focused variants
content.description: Candidates: (a) longer min_stay applied to TQ34b downstream; (b) hysteresis bands (asymmetric thresholds — easier to drop down than to lift up); (c) merge BULL+EX-BULL; (d) require N-consecutive-day confirmation before flip. Each variant must reduce transitions vs TQ34b while preserving directional accuracy.

content.subject: Evaluate with practical objective
content.description: Final scoring = CAGR at TC=0.30% (realistic) + transition count penalty. Avoid metrics that reward over-sensitivity. Compare variants vs TQ34b. Winner must beat TQ34b on the practical objective AND have ≤ TQ34b transition count.

content.subject: BULL↔EX-BULL smoothing variants
content.description: Build variants that handle the 24 BULL↔EX-BULL oscillations: (a) merge into single state, (b) demote EX-BULL to BULL (cap leverage), (c) asymmetric confirmation (require longer confirm for entering leverage), (d) raise threshold for EX-BULL specifically. All built on top of ms15_causal.

content.subject: Multi-TC robustness sweep
content.description: Test winner candidates at TC=0.1%/0.3%/0.5%/0.7%/1.0% to confirm robust improvement under realistic slippage. Winner must beat TQ34b at TC=0.5% AND maintain risk profile (DD, Sharpe).

content.subject: Pre-2014 stress test (2007-2013)
content.description: Run Asymmetric Causal Confirm on 2008 GFC + 2011 inflation crisis + 2012-2013 stagnation. Compare TQ34b vs new variant. Critical: must not fail through severe bear markets. Use standalone 1B VND sim with TC=0.30%.

content.subject: BA v11 integrated backtest
content.description: Locate and run BA v11 production backtest with new state series substituted. Critical because state-machine standalone wins don't [REDACTED] transfer (v2g lesson: +1.28pp standalone but -2.40pp integrated). Compare canonical TQ34b vs new variant on full BA v11 stack.

content.subject: Catalog state dependencies in BA v11
content.description: Identify EVERY state-dependent filter/parameter in BA v11 stack: SV_TIGHT, overheat AVOID, D1 RE_BACKLOG state condition, cash_etf_states, anything inside simulate_holistic_nav.py that uses state_by_date.

content.subject: Build progressive strip variants
content.description: Build BA v11 variants that progressively remove state-deps: strip1 (no SV_TIGHT) → strip2 (no overheat) → strip3 (no D1 state) → strip4 (no cash_etf) → strip_clean (fully state-independent). Replace each removed state dep with state-free proxy.

content.subject: Cross-test strip variants × state series
content.description: Run integrated BA v11 with cross-product: (strip1, strip2, ..., strip_clean) × (TQ34b, DT_10_25_25). Find combination that: (a) maximizes state-independence, (b) achieves OOS performance ≥ TQ34b+full-state-deps baseline.

content.subject: Filter ablation analysis
content.description: Ablate each state-dependent filter individually to measure its marginal value. Identifies most/least impactful filters for tuning prioritization.

content.subject: Tune SV_TIGHT day thresholds
content.description: Sweep SV_TIGHT days_since_release thresholds per state: state 1→[15,30,45], state 2→[30,45,60,90], state 3→[30,45,60,90]. Find combination that improves OOS without overfitting IS.

content.subject: Tune AVOID_bear & overheat
content.description: Test (a) AVOID_bear with FA A/B-tier exempt (defensive stocks allowed in bear), (b) overheat broadened to state 4+5 with different Close/MA200 thresholds. Goal: better OOS risk management.

content.subject: Tune cash_etf parking
content.description: Sweep cash_etf_states: current {3:0.7}; test {2:0.3, 3:0.7}, {2:0.5, 3:0.7, 4:0.3}, {3:0.5} etc. Capture more idle cash productivity.

content.subject: Combined tuning + walk-forward
content.description: Test combinations of top OOS improvers: looser SVT + broader overheat + ETF in bear. Walk-forward validate. Best combo must beat V_PROD on OOS without IS overfit, with DD ≤ 22%.

content.subject: Cross-test filter × state series
content.description: 2×3 matrix: states {TQ34b, DT_10_25_25} × filters {V_PROD, C3_cons, C2_no_svt}. Does best filter tune cross-multiply with state tune, or do they conflict? Identify global optimum (state+filter combination).

content.subject: SVT lever refinement
